description: A TokenWorks strategy designed to acquire Identity MD NFTs with trading fees, resell them and buy back its own token.

relationshipToIMD.text: Identity MD NFTs are the strategy’s target assets. This is a TokenWorks mechanism; its strategy token is distinct from Identity MD’s ecosystem token.

affiliationEvidence.text: No explicit official IMD endorsement was found in the IMD homepage and documentation reviewed. Absence is not evidence of fraud. This listing does not establish an official relationship.

overview.text: The project page identifies IMDStrategy ($IMDSTR), Ethereum and Identity MD as the NFT target. TokenStrategy is branded as powered by TokenWorks.

howItWorks.text: NFT strategy documentation describes a resting 10% trade fee: 8% funds NFT purchases, 1% funds PNKSTR burns and 1% is allocated to collection royalties. NFTs are relisted above cost; sale proceeds fund strategy-token buybacks and burns. This is documented platform behavior, not a verified snapshot of this deployment.

Sources disagree: the listing mentions sale profits distributed to protocol/liquidity providers, while the NFT docs and About page describe all sale proceeds buying and burning strategy tokens. The About page also describes different routing for unclaimed royalties. Exact deployed behavior is unresolved.

securityNotes.text: The FAQ claims audited contracts, but no report tied to this address/version was verified. Audit status is therefore unknown, rather than labeled unaudited.
The documented cycle depends on trades funding purchases and buyers accepting NFT listings. It does not guarantee sales, profit or benefits for IMD holders.
The NFT docs restrict launches to collection owners, while the FAQ uses broader launch language. Neither statement proves this creator is IMD or establishes endorsement.

provenance.text: TokenWorks is the platform provider. The exact strategy deployer and its identity were not independently verified; platform branding does not identify the individual launcher.

overview.text: The dashboard loaded in a browser and exposed a wallet-address lookup plus a separate staking link. It displayed one seat and several unavailable values. Those displayed numbers are not on-chain verification.

howItWorks.text: The website describes fees funding seat purchases, agents earning IMD, staking distributions and compounding. No end-to-end purchase, registration, earnings or payout transaction was independently verified.

securityNotes.text: A material discrepancy needs resolution: marketing says the bot cannot withdraw seats, while config.js says seats live on the keeper, with no separate vault. This review cannot establish enforceable custody protections.
The config provides a seatsOwned fallback. A displayed seat count may therefore survive a failed RPC read; it is not proof of current holdings.

Gridinsoft reports recent domain registration and low reputation. No independent domain-age check or malicious transaction analysis was completed. Automated warnings do not prove fraud, and this review does not classify Hive as fraudulent.

provenance.text: The homepage links @HIVE_imd. The operator, deployer and any IMD relationship have not been independently authenticated.

riskFlags.explanation: The collection is external. Purchases/delivery and holder snapshots rely on a keeper.

overview.text: The rendered coin page labels this token Identity MD Strategy (IMDSTRTGY), with Identity MD as its target and Airdrop as its NFT policy.

howItWorks.text: Nosh documents an 80/20 split of router receipts between collection vault and protocol treasury. Purchased NFTs follow the coin’s policy. For external collections, the keeper performs purchases off-chain and records receipts.
The coin page shows Ethereum delivery links for Identity MD NFTs #1171 and #414. These are project-reported deliveries; transaction execution was not independently checked.

securityNotes.text: Docs acknowledge that the keeper supplies holder snapshots and on-chain logic does not reject a bad root. External vaults permit announced, time-locked withdrawals. These exceptions matter more here than the generic claim that vaults cannot withdraw.
Token liquidity, fee generation, keeper availability, snapshot honesty and cross-chain custody all affect outcomes. A raffle is not a guaranteed reward or a claim on an IMD agent.

provenance.text: Nosh’s coin page reports creator 0xebC1188F54B8591eb3322b273391a2f4a714dBd4. The wallet’s real-world identity and deployed ownership were not independently authenticated. Nosh is separate from Identity MD.
